@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+package info
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+// Version is the version of the running Flipt binary, set by the CLI at startup.
+var Version = "dev"
+
+// Flipt describes the running binary and available updates.
+type Flipt struct {
+	Version         string `json:"version,omitempty"`
+	LatestVersion   string `json:"latestVersion,omitempty"`
+	Commit          string `json:"commit,omitempty"`
+	BuildDate       string `json:"buildDate,omitempty"`
+	GoVersion       string `json:"goVersion,omitempty"`
+	UpdateAvailable bool   `json:"updateAvailable"`
+	IsRelease       bool   `json:"isRelease"`
+}
+
+// ServeHTTP writes the Flipt metadata as JSON.
+func (i Flipt) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	out, err := json.Marshal(i)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, "encoding info", http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	if _, err = w.Write(out); err != nil {
+		// The response may already have been committed; a second status cannot be sent.
+		http.Error(w, "writing info", http.StatusInternalServerError)
+	}
+}
diff --git a/telemetry/telemetry.go b/telemetry/telemetry.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0cb1511
--- /dev/null
+++ b/telemetry/telemetry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+// Package telemetry reports anonymous installation usage when enabled.
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/internal/info"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+)
+
+const (
+	schemaVersion = "1.0"
+	interval      = 4 * time.Hour
+	// Telemetry collector endpoint.
+	endpoint = "https://telemetry.flipt.io/v1/track"
+)
+
+type state struct {
+	Version       string `json:"version"`
+	UUID          string `json:"uuid"`
+	LastTimestamp string `json:"lastTimestamp"`
+}
+
+type event struct {
+	AnonymousID string `json:"anonymousId"`
+	Event       string `json:"event"`
+	Properties  struct {
+		UUID    string `json:"uuid"`
+		Version string `json:"version"`
+		Flipt   struct {
+			Version string `json:"version"`
+		} `json:"flipt"`
+	} `json:"properties"`
+	Context struct {
+		IP string `json:"ip"`
+	} `json:"context"`
+}
+
+// Reporter owns the persistent anonymous identifier and reporting schedule.
+type Reporter struct {
+	mu     sync.Mutex
+	path   string
+	state  state
+	client *http.Client
+	url    string
+	logger logrus.FieldLogger
+}
+
+// NewReporter prepares telemetry state. Disabled telemetry has no filesystem effects.
+func NewReporter(cfg *config.Config, logger logrus.FieldLogger) (*Reporter, error) {
+	if cfg == nil || !cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	dir := cfg.Meta.StateDirectory
+	if dir == "" {
+		var err error
+		dir, err = os.UserConfigDir()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("finding telemetry state directory: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry state directory: %w", err)
+	}
+	r := &Reporter{path: filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json"), client: &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}, url: endpoint, logger: logger}
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(r.path)
+	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &r.state); err != nil {
+			logger.Warnf("reading telemetry state: %v; generating new identifier", err)
+			r.state = state{}
+		}
+	}
+	parsed, parseErr := uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID)
+	if parseErr != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil {
+		id, err := uuid.NewV4()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("generating telemetry identifier: %w", err)
+		}
+		r.state.UUID = id.String()
+	}
+	r.state.Version = schemaVersion
+	if r.state.LastTimestamp != "" {
+		if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp); err != nil {
+			r.state.LastTimestamp = ""
+		}
+	}
+	if err := r.save(); err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("writing telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+	return r, nil
+}
+
+// Start reports when due and continues at four-hour intervals until cancellation.
+func (r *Reporter) Start(ctx context.Context) {
+	if r == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	go func() {
+		var retryAt time.Time
+		for {
+			r.mu.Lock()
+			last, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp)
+			r.mu.Unlock()
+			next := last.Add(interval)
+			if retryAt.After(next) {
+				next = retryAt
+			}
+			delay := time.Until(next)
+			if delay < 0 {
+				delay = 0
+			}
+			timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
+			select {
+			case <-ctx.Done():
+				if !timer.Stop() {
+					select {
+					case <-timer.C:
+					default:
+					}
+				}
+				return
+			case <-timer.C:
+			}
+			if err := r.Report(ctx); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
+				r.logger.Warnf("reporting telemetry: %v", err)
+				retryAt = time.Now().Add(interval)
+			} else {
+				retryAt = time.Time{}
+			}
+		}
+	}()
+}
+
+// Report sends one anonymous ping and records its successful delivery time.
+func (r *Reporter) Report(ctx context.Context) error {
+	if r == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	var e event
+	e.AnonymousID = r.state.UUID
+	e.Event = "flipt.ping"
+	e.Properties.UUID = r.state.UUID
+	e.Properties.Version = schemaVersion
+	e.Properties.Flipt.Version = info.Version
+	e.Context.IP = "0.0.0.0"
+	body, err := json.Marshal(e)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("encoding telemetry event: %w", err)
+	}
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, r.url, bytes.NewReader(body))
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry request: %w", err)
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	resp, err := r.client.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry event: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
+	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry event: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
+	}
+	old := r.state.LastTimestamp
+	r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+	if err := r.save(); err != nil {
+		r.state.LastTimestamp = old
+		return fmt.Errorf("writing telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) save() error {
+	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(r.state, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	f, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(r.path), ".telemetry-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	defer os.Remove(f.Name())
+	if err := f.Chmod(0600); err != nil {
+		f.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	if _, err := f.Write(data); err != nil {
+		f.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return os.Rename(f.Name(), r.path)
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bf4678d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/telemetry/telemetry_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/internal/info"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestDisabled(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "absent")
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled = false
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, r)
+	_, err = os.Stat(dir)
+	require.True(t, os.IsNotExist(err))
+}
+
+func TestDirectoryIsFile(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "file")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("x"), 0600))
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = path
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, r)
+}
+
+func TestReportAndPersistentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	path := filepath.Join(dir, "telemetry.json")
+	before := readState(t, path)
+	require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, before.Version)
+	_, err = uuid.FromString(before.UUID)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, before.LastTimestamp)
+
+	previous := info.Version
+	info.Version = "v1.2.3"
+	defer func() { info.Version = previous }()
+	calls := 0
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
+		calls++
+		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, req.Method)
+		var got event
+		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&got))
+		require.Equal(t, "flipt.ping", got.Event)
+		require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.AnonymousID)
+		require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.Properties.UUID)
+		require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, got.Properties.Version)
+		require.Equal(t, "v1.2.3", got.Properties.Flipt.Version)
+		require.Equal(t, "0.0.0.0", got.Context.IP)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	r.url = srv.URL
+	require.NoError(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
+	require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
+	after := readState(t, path)
+	require.Equal(t, before.UUID, after.UUID)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	again, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, before.UUID, again.state.UUID)
+}
+
+func TestFailedReportDoesNotAdvanceTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadGateway) }))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	r.url = srv.URL
+	require.Error(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
+	require.Empty(t, readState(t, r.path).LastTimestamp)
+}
+
+func TestMalformedStateGetsNewIdentity(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
+	path := filepath.Join(cfg.Meta.StateDirectory, "telemetry.json")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`{"uuid":"bad","lastTimestamp":"invalid"}`), 0600))
+	r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, r.state.LastTimestamp)
+}
+
+func readState(t *testing.T, path string) state {
+	t.Helper()
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	var s state
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &s))
+	return s
+}
